designationHistory.indexText: Established as a refuge for breeding and migratory birds and other wildlife while being an inviolate sanctuary for migratory birds. 1939 - The Bureau of Biological Survey from the Department of Agriculture and the Bureau of Fisheries from the Department of Commerce were transferred to the Department of the Interior and became the U.S.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
